_note: Invented tool list for a ticket tracker. Descriptions are written to show the size, not copied from a product.

tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Search issues by text, status, assignee or label. Returns up to 50 matches with id, title, status and assignee. Use this to find an issue before reading or changing it.

query.description: Free text to match in the title and body.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Read one issue by id, including its description, comments and history.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new issue. Changes the tracker. Ask the user before you call it.

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Change the title, body, status, assignee or labels of an issue. Changes the tracker. Ask the user before you call it.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an issue. Changes the tracker and notifies watchers. Ask the user before you call it.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: List every label in use, with the number of issues that carry it.

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List the people who can be assigned an issue.

tools.name: get_board
tools.description: Read a board and the issues in each of its columns. Use search_issues instead when you know what you are looking for.
